create.name: Yehuda Ashkenazi
create.bio:
Yehuda Ashkenazi, known to many as Ashke, is a Kabbalah teacher and musician who grew up in Israel and now teaches in Los Angeles. Music came first: he trained at music school and was recording his first album when he met the teachings of Kabbalah, and he went on to study under Rav Berg and Karen Berg. He has taught with The Kabbalah Centre for more than two decades, in Israel and the United States, leading Zohar study, classes on the spiritual tools of the tradition and one-to-one guidance sessions in person and online.

His particular contribution is Sacred Sounds, a form of meditation that weaves live music, tones and the sounds of the Hebrew letters into a guided session meant to slow the mind and open a quieter, more receptive awareness. He offers it to individuals, to groups at the Beverly Hills centre, on the Centre's Weekly Energy Boost broadcasts and in sessions for companies. His recordings include daily meditations on the 72 Names of God and the Ana Bekoach prayer, and he releases songs as The Yehuda Ashkenazi Project and under the name Ashke.

courses.title: Private session with Yehuda Ashkenazi
courses.description: A one-to-one guidance session with Yehuda, booked through The Kabbalah Centre, online or in person and lasting 30, 50 or 60 minutes. Sessions apply Kabbalistic ideas and tools to relationships, family life and personal growth.

courses.title: Sacred Sounds Meditation session
courses.description: A private Kabbalistic sound meditation with Yehuda, using music, tones and frequencies to settle the mind into a deeper, more receptive state for reflection and inner guidance. Booked through The Kabbalah Centre's guidance service.

courses.title: Sacred Sounds & Astrology: The New Moon of Sagittarius
courses.description: A one-evening group sound meditation led by Yehuda at The Kabbalah Centre in Beverly Hills, timed to the new moon in Sagittarius. Places are booked online.

courses.title: Kabbalistic Sound Meditation
courses.description: A two-day Insight Timer course of guided sound meditations, about half an hour each, built from music, tones and the sounds of Hebrew letters and sacred names, with one day centred on the crown and one on the heart.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Yehuda Ashkenazi on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Yehuda's Kabbalistic sound meditations and short teachings, combining live music with Hebrew letters and sacred names. Free to hear in the app or on the web.
